en.p: In coordinate space there is a sphere $S$ with center $\mathrm{A}(0,\,0,\,1)$ and radius $4$. Let $C$ be the circle formed where sphere $S$ meets the $xy$-plane, and take two points $\mathrm{P}$, $\mathrm{Q}$ on circle $C$ so that the distance from point $\mathrm{A}$ to segment $\mathrm{PQ}$ is $2$. When point $\mathrm{B}$ moves on the circle formed where sphere $S$ meets the sphere $T$ with diameter $\mathrm{PQ}$, what is the maximum area of the orthogonal projection of triangle $\mathrm{BPQ}$ onto the $xy$-plane? (The $z$-coordinate of point $\mathrm{B}$ is positive.) [4 points]
